userGoal: Reduce regression feedback time and make test ownership easier to maintain.
nonGoals: Do not force shared-state tests into four-way concurrency.
Do not alter production behavior or weaken assertions.
inScope: Classify test files by isolation and runtime cost.
Expose explicit unit, shared-state, and regression suite commands.
Run proven isolated unit tests with --test-concurrency=4.
Record baseline and post-change runtime plus repeated-run stability.
outOfScope: Changing test assertions solely to make concurrency pass.
allowedTestSeams: npm test scripts and package test commands
Node.js built-in test runner discovery and concurrency flags
Test directory structure and suite manifests
completionCriteria: Isolated suite passes at four-way concurrency.
Repeated runs show no new flaky failures.
